target.statement: SCL achieves 79.74 IR@1 on zero-shot image-text retrieval on Flickr30K (evaluating the pre-trained model directly)
target.dataset: Flickr30K (zero-shot retrieval using the pre-trained model)

compute.basis: The target requires the paper's pre-trained checkpoint (or reproducing pre-training), which was trained for 100k steps with batch size 4096 on 64 NVIDIA A100 GPUs on 4M images; even inference of the full model on Flickr30K is heavy, and reproducing pre-training on a CPU-only laptop is infeasible.

blockers: Pre-training requires 64 A100 GPUs for 100k steps (image-text) plus 10k steps (video-text)
No pre-trained checkpoint is confirmed to be released; reproducing the model from scratch is required
Large pre-training corpora (COCO, VG, CC3M, SBU, WebVid) need to be downloaded and processed
CPU-only laptop cannot run the required training or even efficient inference of the full model
title: Seeing What You Miss: Vision-Language Pre-training with Semantic Completion Learning
